ignored.text: [RPG] ERROR: detailsElement not found - probably not on Generate tab
ignored.ignored_reason: REAL DEFECT, deliberately not gating. Our own pack logs console.error on a buyer's first load of the workflow. Read at OFMTech-NSFW/ComfyUI_INSTARAW/js/reality_prompt_generator.js:8280-8282: it is the else branch of 'if (detailsElement)', and the only thing it skips is detailsElement.addEventListener('toggle', updateDetailsContent) on the advanced-settings <details> panel. Execution continues straight on to attach the Generate button handler at :8284 and everything after it, so nothing is broken - the panel simply is not on the active tab (the log line immediately before it reads 'Current active tab: library', and 'Total <details> elements: 0'). Cosmetic, but our pack should not shout ERROR at a buyer for a condition it handles. One-line fix (console.error -> console.debug) in a file WS3 also touches. Written up in notes/WS2-report.md.
